challenges: Plan Cuivre (2023-2030 Copper Network Decommissioning): Executing commercial and technical shutdown of ~30M+ legacy RTC/ADSL copper lines across 35,000 French municipalities under strict ARCEP wholesale/retail regulation while migrating remaining subscribers to FTTH without churn or SLA penalties.

Orange Business B2B Margin Turnaround: Reversing structural -4.8% top-line contraction (€7.33B) and legacy MPLS/fixed-voice erosion by migrating enterprise accounts onto the cloud-native Evolution Platform (SD-WAN/SASE/NaaS), Live Intelligence multi-LLM services, and profitable IT integration.

5G Standalone (5G SA), Open RAN & eCapEx Capital Efficiency: Holding eCapEx near ~15.4% of revenue (€6.21B) while scaling cloud-native 5G SA core network slicing, multi-vendor Open RAN (OTIC validation), and expanding telecom ROCE (5.5%-6.9%) decisively above WACC (~4.1%).

Network Energy Optimization & Totem TowerCo Co-Tenancy: Curbing base-station and central-office electrical OPEX across 26,883 Totem macro-sites via AI sleep states and copper switch-off while raising Totem third-party co-tenancy from 1.46x toward >1.50x.

Sovereign AI & European Cybersecurity Compliance (ANSSI / NIS2 / EU AI Act / SecNumCloud): Scaling Orange Cyberdefense (~€1.3B revenue, +6.8% YoY) despite acute European Tier-3 SOC analyst shortages and governing internal/commercial GenAI (Dinootoo / Live Intelligence with Mistral AI & OpenAI) under strict French and EU sovereignty rules.
